description: This file manages the import validation for plugin SDK source files, ensuring they do not import legacy or monolithic SDK paths, and collects relevant plugin source files for validation.

methods.name: hasMonolithicRootImport
methods.description: Checks if the content contains an import of the monolithic openclaw/plugin-sdk path.

methods.name: hasLegacyCompatImport
methods.description: Checks if the content contains an import of the legacy openclaw/plugin-sdk/compat path.

methods.name: collectPluginSourceFiles
methods.description: Collects plugin source files from a specified root directory, excluding certain directories.

methods.name: collectSharedExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Collects shared extension source files from the extensions/shared directory.

methods.name: collectBundledExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Collects source files from bundled extensions directories, excluding 'shared'.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates plugin source validation and outputs status.
